questions.q: How many kinds of awe does Keltner identify?
questions.why: Lesson 1 gives a taxonomy of eight sources.

questions.q: Which kind of awe comes from watching others show virtue?

a: The electrifying group experience, like a concert

questions.q: What does lesson 2 say about money and awe?
a: Awe has little to do with money, status or success
questions.why: Lesson 2 says anyone can feel awe, and wealth barely helps.

questions.q: Which hormone does moral beauty trigger?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says seeing goodness triggers oxytocin.
